evidence:
Scope and authority: Opened both actual frozen XLSX files with openpyxl. Quality Checks!A39:D39 says scored prompts must score each criterion on its own and continue after a failure, with gates exempt. Internal Quality Checks!A39:D39 confirms that one miss must not zero the rest. Deterministic Checks!A5:C5 names check-batched-independence-wording.py. The frozen skill's references/quality-checks.md:156-159 and deterministic-checks.md section check-batched-independence-wording.py require this same instruction. Applied qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md's independent-outcome-credit correction. Independently SHA256-verified all 84 task/rules files from manifest.json; no mismatches.

All scored dimensions inspected, not a sample: parsed every judge.toml. Functional has 64 criteria, Polish 7, Visual 6; each declares mode='batched' and aggregation='weighted_mean' (functional/judge.toml:3,21; polish/judge.toml:3,15; visual/judge.toml:3,15). Both gate dimensions use all_pass and are exempt. Paths below are relative to the frozen task/tests directory.

Functional: scored/functional/prompt.md:9 says 'Never ... inherit another row's verdict, or apply an all-legs score to a whole protocol' and 'Every row needs its own result, including a failure.' Line 11 says 'Continue collecting unrelated evidence' and requires a stated independent fallback when an earlier product failure blocks evidence. Line 100 requires 'Reuse actual control facts, including facts from a partly failing protocol' and 'Preserve separately observed results when another part fails.' I read the entire 460-line prompt and all 64 descriptors; no instruction tells the judge to stop on its first ordinary failure. Concrete refinements preserve independence after failed uppercase extensions/HTML dispatch (143-149), harmless-word refusal (220), JS error setup or reporting (265-272), timer/Promise error versus recovery (313,341), CSS timer failure versus duration (370), debounce-reset failure versus off-state protection (379), restart survival versus later writing (409-415), and first conflict recovery versus the second refusal trial (425).

Polish: scored/polish/prompt.md:34-39 explicitly says 'Score each criterion independently' and 'After an ordinary failure, continue to the remaining criteria and return a verdict for every one.' Its shared tour at line 49 says a missing label or failed navigation step must not cancel other observations and permits pointer setup to reach later surfaces without pretending that pointer use proves a keyboard route. All seven descriptors retain separate observable ownership; judge.toml:50 explicitly preserves focus credit for reached controls when some other control is unreachable.

Visual: scored/visual/prompt.md:46 says 'Score every criterion independently and continue after an ordinary failure.' Lines 47-51 apply the relevant anchor to unavailable product surfaces without fabricating observations, and lines 13-22 prohibit inheriting functional or mobile usability failures. All six Likert descriptors were inspected. Shared injected app_context.md:24 says 'never inherit another outcome's verdict' and retain valid sibling observations after a failure; line 28 directs the judge to return supported remaining outcomes and says unavailable observation must not erase unrelated observed credit.

Counterexample attempts: A fully conforming implementation using native/composite keyboard controls and an initially empty library is accepted by Polish prompt:43-47, while Visual prompt:37 permits empty console/library state, so these alternatives do not create a hidden cascade. For a partial implementation that reports the wrong JS error line but restores the last-good render and successfully executes recovery, Functional prompt:272 and judge.toml:175,182,434 preserve rollback/recovery credit while failing the line outcome. A broken app with dead Auto-run cannot falsely pass off-state suppression merely through silence: prompt:379 and judge.toml:294,301 require an observed successful automatic execution, but do not import the debounce-reset verdict. A lost-record restart followed by working new writes uses the explicit independent fresh-record fallback at prompt:413. These source-level witnesses did not expose a false-pass/false-fail instruction for this row.

The global browser prerequisite can zero a dimension (functional prompt:5; polish prompt:13-22; visual prompt:24-33); this is the explicit staged profile exception and is distinguished from ordinary feature failures. The canonical scorer's gates/floor and test.sh's whole-process failure behavior are not stop-on-first-criterion instructions. Source review and TOML parsing establish this wording check only. raw-evidence-index.json lists scripted browser evidence and explicitly states that no full configured verifier/LLM judge, Oracle or target-model evidence is supplied. No such runtime was run or inferred here; runtime adherence remains unmeasured.
